title: Normalize chat send and stop control sizing

context: User reported the chat arrow is larger than normal. Current source uses 40pt bordered controls, which add extra visual bulk. This is a focused correction separate from the broader Orb/startup/rendering task.

Do not modify provider/runtime logic or unrelated UI.
Do not claim physical-device verification from CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: Send and stop controls use a compact 34pt circular style.
Send remains disabled for blank input and both accessibility labels remain intact.
Only the two declared paths change.
verification: Run python3 Scripts/agent_task_guard.py check-diff Tasks/active/PAUI-29.json --base origin/main.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA gates.
